title: Exact transposition-local delta for globally injective B/A charge
statement: For s=2^h>=2 and any fixed complete globally injected f,g and two distinct original point factors u,v, swap the global assigned physical pair labels f(u),f(v). The exact B/A charge difference equals the quintic sum over supports {p} union A intersecting {u,v}; all other terms cancel exactly.

quantifiers.domain: complete original globally injected point and line maps
two distinct original point factors of W(3,s)

external_dependencies: Global bijective transposition of two assigned physical labels preserves typed injection.
limitations: A one-transposition local optimum need not be globally optimal.
Finite adversarial W32 search does not yield all-h global counterfamily.
Does not establish a universal lower bound for all maps.
falsification_boundary: Only swap moves in one complete global f, not per-Q relabeling nor an exhaustive global search.
